apps.name: Introduction to Psychology
apps.summary: The PSYCH-C1000 course site at Modesto Junior College: syllabus, Know Your Professor, and links to the class activities.

apps.name: Myth or Fact?
apps.summary: Each student gets one claim about psychology and locks in true or false; answers stay hidden until the class hears the magic word.

apps.name: Make a Face
apps.summary: Partners take turns acting out an emotion with only face and shoulders while the other guesses: 12 emotions, 15 seconds each.

apps.name: Cyberball
apps.summary: The classic social-exclusion demo: toss a ball with two other players until they stop throwing it to you.

apps.name: The Heist
apps.summary: Secretly tells each student whether to steal a prize and whether to lie about it, so the class can practice detecting deception.

apps.name: Spot the Dangerous Criminal
apps.summary: Pick the violent offender out of three booking photographs, then see how close to chance you scored.

apps.name: 3D Brain: Neocortex
apps.summary: Spin a 3D model of the cortex and click any lobe or area to see its name and what it does.

apps.name: 3D Brain: Limbic System
apps.summary: A 3D model of the limbic system. Click a structure to see its name and role in emotion and memory.

apps.name: Attribution Theory
apps.summary: Classify the causes of everyday behavior: internal or external, stable or unstable.

apps.name: Social Exchange Theory
apps.summary: Set Outcomes, CL, and CL-alt to see how the theory predicts satisfaction and dependence.

apps.name: Social Personality Scale
apps.summary: Twelve statements that score your shyness and introversion separately.

apps.name: Triangular Theory of Love
apps.summary: Mix passion, intimacy, and commitment to discover Sternberg's eight types of love.

apps.name: Love Mixer
apps.summary: Set passion, intimacy, and commitment to high or low, then mix to discover which type of love you've made.

apps.name: The Love Doctor
apps.summary: Diagnose each couple's type of love from what they tell you about passion, intimacy, and commitment.

apps.name: Love Languages Survey
apps.summary: See 20 things a partner might do and rate how much each would mean to you to find your love language.

apps.name: What's Your Attachment Style?
apps.summary: A 12-item questionnaire that places you on the anxiety–avoidance map of attachment styles.

apps.name: Read the Texts
apps.summary: Text back and forth with three people, each hiding an attachment style, and work out which one from how they reply.

apps.name: Style Matcher
apps.summary: Pick two attachment styles to see their satisfaction potential, tension points, and how they handle conflict.

apps.name: Changing Marriage Rates
apps.summary: How the share of married U.S. adults ages 25–34 fell from 86 to 34 per 100 between 1970 and 2025.

Pick a Year · Top Hat embed, 3 years

apps.name: Dating Messages Simulator
apps.summary: Adjust height and salary to see how each relates to the number of messages received on dating apps.

apps.name: Fast Face Judgments
apps.summary: Pairs of faces flash faster every round, down to 60 ms, to show how quickly we judge attractiveness.

links.label: Why some faces are more attractive

apps.name: Achievement Motivation Scale
apps.summary: Score your needs for achievement, power, and affiliation from McClelland's theory.

apps.name: Commitment to UC Merced
apps.summary: Rate your commitment to UC Merced on Meyer & Allen's affective, continuance, and normative dimensions.

apps.name: The Dark Triad
apps.summary: A Halloween-themed survey of Machiavellianism, narcissism, and psychopathy.

apps.name: Big Five Personality Survey
apps.summary: Twenty IPIP-NEO items, one per screen, scoring your openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness, and neuroticism.

apps.name: Emotional & Social Intelligence
apps.summary: Twenty statements that score how well you read your own emotions against how well you read other people.

apps.name: Reading the Mind in the Eyes
apps.summary: Judge what a person is thinking or feeling from the eye region alone, across 36 photographs.

apps.name: Groupthink: Four Cases
apps.summary: Each student gets one of four real cases, from a Soviet sub's near-launch to the Mozart effect, then finds classmates holding a different one.

apps.name: Subtext
apps.summary: Partners pass a phone back and forth, saying lines like "Good job." with only nonverbal cues to convey a secret meaning.

apps.name: Human Sexuality
apps.summary: An open online textbook by Dr. Ross Avilla: 15 chapters with pop-up definitions and practice questions.

apps.name: Anatomy Point-and-Click
apps.summary: Click each marker to reveal the name of each part of the vulva. Includes a male version.

apps.name: 3D Reproductive Anatomy
apps.summary: Rotate a 3D model of the reproductive system and click any structure to see its name and what it does.

apps.name: Fetal Genital Development
apps.summary: Click along a timeline to see how the genitals develop in the womb for female and male fetuses.

apps.name: How to Use a Condom
apps.summary: A step-by-step slideshow on using a condom correctly, starting with checking the expiration date.

apps.name: The Hook-Up Game
apps.summary: Model a year of choices (partners, condoms, HPV vaccination), see your odds of an STI, then roll the dice.

apps.name: Describing Orgasm
apps.summary: A classroom replication of Vance & Wagner (1976): describe an orgasm anonymously, then guess each writer's anatomy.

apps.name: Position Yourself
apps.summary: An inclusive, mobile-first guide to 56 sex positions sorted by body arrangement, plus a partner matcher quiz.

apps.name: KinkDeck
apps.summary: Swipe through 20 cards across 10 kinks for a quick, playful breakdown. Nothing is stored.

apps.name: Locus of Control
apps.summary: A 20-question quiz that places you from internal to external locus of control across five bands.

apps.name: TAT Images
apps.summary: Picture cards for a Thematic Apperception Test (TAT) demonstration.

apps.name: Class Check-In
apps.summary: Students enter the session code from the instructor to check in, and attendance is recorded in Google Sheets.

apps.name: Semester Grid
apps.summary: Build a week-by-week class schedule for a semester and paste the table straight into Google Docs.

apps.name: Exam Grade Distribution
apps.summary: Merge Canvas exam scores into the gradebook, preview a curve, and export Canvas-ready files and a PDF report.

apps.name: Student Names
apps.summary: Flashcards for learning students' names from their photos, with a tab per class and swipe-to-mark.

apps.name: Teaching Review Archive
apps.summary: A monthly scan of 21 psychology journals, matched to lectures, with ready-made slide text for each new finding.

apps.name: From Prompt to App
apps.summary: A walkthrough for instructors: describe a class activity in plain language, have AI write the app, and publish it.

apps.name: DECA Family Hub
apps.summary: The Denair Elementary Charter Academy calendar, bell schedule, lunch menu, and Parents Club events.

apps.name: Fun for Nathaniel
apps.summary: Kid-friendly events around Turlock on weekends and school breaks, with one-tap Google Calendar links.

apps.name: Week Plan
apps.summary: Pick the week's meals and get a shopping list and Sunday prep plan built from them.

apps.name: KB Builder
apps.summary: A kettlebell workout builder with a round tracker, demo videos, and a library of 82 moves.

apps.name: Counter
apps.summary: A minimal tap-to-count app.
